properties.NAME: Disputed Area
properties.CHANGE: The U.S. and Spanish West Florida both claimed area south of Mississippi Terr. between the Mississippi and Perdido Rivers. Spain actually governed the area. Map depicts the disputed area in present Miss. and Ala.
properties.CITATION: (U.S. Stat., vol. 2, ch. 38[1804], sec.1/p. 283; Van Zandt, 107)
